	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	  UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER ,PREAUTHORIZATION_ID ,LAST_NAME ,FIRST_NAME ,MIDDLE_INIT ,DOB ,GENDER ,RACE_ETHNICITY ,PRIMARY_LANGUAGE ,MARITAL_STATUS ,RESIDENT_ADDRESS ,CITY ,STATE ,ZIP_CODE ,COUNTY ,PHONE_NUMBER ,EMAIL_ADDRESS ,ADMISSION_DATE ,EXPECTED_DISCHARGE_DATE ,DISCHARGE_DATE ,ADMITTING_DIAGNOSIS ,CURRENT_TREATING_PHYSICIAN_NPI ,FACILITY_NPI ,FACILITY_NAME ,ROOM_TYPE ,THIRTY_DAYS_READMIT_FLAG ,PRIOR_ADMIT_DATE ,CSCS_ID												 FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CO_BH_IP_DAILY_AUTH_CENSUS_STG WHERE CREATE_DATE > GETDATE()-1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableCOBHIPDAILYAUTHCENSUSSTG
SourceTableCOBHIPDAILYAUTHCENSUSSTG split(COUNTY == 'GILPIN' || COUNTY == 'BOULDER' || COUNTY == 'BROOMFIELD' || COUNTY == 'CLEAR CREEK',COUNTY == 'EL PASO' || COUNTY == 'PARK' || COUNTY == 'TELLER',COUNTY == 'DENVER' || COUNTY == 'JEFFERSON', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Clinica,Diversus,FrontRange,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Clinica derive({} = {}) ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount
ConditionalSplit@Diversus derive() ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount2
ConditionalSplit@FrontRange derive() ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount1
